Once the season is finished, this notice may be removed. Read at your own risk! Cat Witch is a masked celebrity contestant on the fourteenth season of The Masked Singer. Contents 1 Appearance 2 Songs 3 Clues 3.1 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Clue 3.2 Valentine’s Clue 3.3 Colossal Clue 3.4 Connection Clue 3.5 Crack The Case Clue Case 4 Final Guesses 5 Trivia 6 Gallery 7 References Appearance TBA Songs Week Song Selection Result 1 "Abracadabra" by Lady Gaga WIN 4 "Teenage Dream" by Katy Perry SAFE 6 "It Will Rain" by Bruno Mars SAFE 10 "Starships" by Nicki Minaj SAFE 11 "Run to You" by Whitney Houston SAFE 12 "Leave (Get Out)" by JoJo SAFE "Greedy" by Tate McRae THIRD PLACE "Denim" by Kylie Cantrall UNMASKED Clues Week Clues 1 “The best things are worth the wait. And don’t I know that’s true. I’m not used to being anonymous. But I’m thrilled to toy with you. Ever since I was a kitten, I longed for the stage. So I brewed myself a future. A dash of time, a little sage, grandiose merch, tours, albums. All that and more came from my cauldrons. And I’m living for it. This little kitten’s got her claws in every single pot. Because to live nine lives, you’ve got to grow and stretch a lot. I’m ready to shed my image. A more mature side you should find. And what I’m manifesting next, that gold mask is mine.” 4 “One of the coolest thing about the Ninja Turtles has always been collecting the action figures. It was a first question I asked when I became a star: Am I going to be a toy? The first time I saw it at Walmart, I freaked out. And to my surprise, they couldn’t keep them on the shelves. But the coolest part? Knowing it’s probably the first action figure that some kids will ever get. That’s a dream come true. See you in the toy box.” 6 “OMG, I was dying to see if Bella would choose Edward or Jacob. I know what it’ like to be torn between two suitors. I had my eye on an Edward myself. A dreamer who was shiny and irresistible.But a Jacob appeared. He was pretty cool too, and he wanted me bad. I knew how rare the opportunity was. The proposal of a lifetime! But it didn’t feel right to me. So I walked away, Everyone was like, ‘girl, you’re crazy!’ And I started to believe them. A few months later, the phone rang. And it was the call I was waiting for. My Edward! And finally, everything felt right. I’m most proud of that moment, for trusting I’d find my soulmate. I said ‘I do,’ and the rest is sweet.” 10 “This is a totally new frontier for me. But guess what, panel. I’ve been playing more games with you than you know. Especially you, Robin Thicke. Because spoiler alert, I come from a very talented family. One of whom has worked closely with you.” 11 “My journal, I write all my personal secrets in it. But tonight, turn to page 20 for my top secret entry: A letter for someone special: Mom. All of this is possible because of you. You believed in me as a little girl and showed me exactly who I could be. And when I landed a role in a huge franchise, you were right by my side. The older I get, the more I relate to you. All those lessons you taught me, maybe I didn’t understand them at the time. I think I get it now. And while my life story is still being written, I feel safe following in your footsteps. You’re such a queen. Now watch me go after the crown.” 12 “I was the little girl who would practice performances all day, waiting for my parents to come home from work to show them what I could do. I’ve always had big dreams, and they’re still coming true. The last few years have been a total whirlwind. I remember going out on Halloween and seeing all these little girls dressed up like me. And I’m so thankful. But it’s a lot of pressure. I’m growing up now, and trying to figure out who I am. To be taken seriously. Who knew becoming Cat Witch was exactly what I needed. Being here I’ve grown so much and learned that I’m confident, powerful, sexy, fun. And I’m ready for whatever’s next. But I’m going to miss this. It’s been the best experience.” Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Clue Clue Info Pocket watch that says 10:10 “With limited time in the business, I’ve starred in some incredible films and movies. In fact, I think some of you have watched them.” Valentine’s Clue Clue Info Chocolate turkey “Over 30 million people watched me on one very special big day. And I was riding high.” Colossal Clue Clue Info Black Swan and Piglet “Robin’s not the only one with ties to my talented family. JoJo and Nick Lachey have ties too.” Connection Clue Relation Info Robin Thicke “Robin, last time I told you worked with one of my family members. But we know each other because you welcomed my family into your home. You recorded with one of my parents. Also have a connection with Rita.” Crack The Case Clue Case Clue Info Mousetrap delivered by bestie, Meg Donnelly “I’ve never been afraid of a mouse. In fact, one helped launch my whole career.” Clue Answers "The mouse trap is a clue to Kylie's breakout roles for Disney" Final Guesses Week Robin's Guess Jenny's Guess Ken's Guess Rita's Guess 12 Victoria Justice Kylie Cantrall Ashley Tisdale Kylie Cantrall Trivia Cat Witch is the second contestant in the international franchise to be revealed while also staying in the competition. The song "Teenage Dream" is the song Leopard sang in Season 2. Brandy Norwood was originally going to be Cat Witch's bestie, but couldn't film in time due to her touring.
